usedFor: Eledo builds documents from your templates with “Create PDF From Template” and returns a download link.

bestTemplate.name: “New Clock In” in Jibble, then “Create PDF From Template” in Eledo
bestTemplate.why: Each clock-in can produce a document from your template, with a download link.

watchOut: A link from “Create PDF From Template” sent to someone outside waits for your approval.
